claim_boundary: The lease governs WHEN an absolute may be taken, not what it means. A protected window makes an absolute eligible; it does not make a dirty-source build clean or a single run repeatable.

contaminated_window.reserved_why: canonical absolutes and any number used for promotion
contaminated_window.why: absolutes move with load while ratios do not - isolated qkvz read 601 GB/s in one run and 347 in another while its ARM A ratio held at 1.57x both times. A matched pair is valid under contention.

measurement_provenance.why: a hardware number that cannot be placed in time cannot be audited against a contention window

policy.does_not_ask_each_time: the user decided this for G075; re-asking is the ceremony S025 §41 says to remove
